CREATE TABLE "public"."AdminMfa" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "totpConfirmedAt" timestamptz,
  "totpSecretEnc" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."AdminRecoveryCode" (
  "codeHash" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "mfaId" text NOT NULL,
  "usedAt" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."AuditEvent" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "actorId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "detail" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "ipHash" text,
  "policyVersion" text,
  "reason" text,
  "resourceId" text,
  "resourceType" text,
  "sessionId" text,
  "subjectId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."BetaCohortMembership" (
  "acceptedAt" timestamptz,
  "cohort" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "invitedAt" timestamptz,
  "invitedBy" text,
  "notes" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'invited' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "BetaCohortMembership_cohort_check_008d7f38" CHECK ("cohort" IN ('internal', 'founding_seller', 'private_beta_buyer')),
  CONSTRAINT "BetaCohortMembership_status_check_c34e9cfa" CHECK ("status" IN ('invited', 'active', 'suspended', 'exited'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."OtpCode" (
  "attempts" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "channel" text NOT NULL,
  "codeHash" text NOT NULL,
  "consumedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "purpose" text NOT NULL,
  "target" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "OtpCode_channel_check_d360ded9" CHECK ("channel" IN ('email', 'phone')),
  CONSTRAINT "OtpCode_purpose_check_e0deb69d" CHECK ("purpose" IN ('email_verification', 'phone_verification', 'password_recovery'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."PolicyAcceptance" (
  "acceptedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "policyKey" text NOT NULL,
  "policyVersion" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."SellerVerification" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "method" text DEFAULT 'operations_review' NOT NULL,
  "note" text,
  "policyVersion" text NOT NULL,
  "reasonCode" text,
  "reviewedAt" timestamptz,
  "reviewerId" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "submittedAt" timestamptz,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "SellerVerification_method_check_b1d86172" CHECK ("method" IN ('operations_review')),
  CONSTRAINT "SellerVerification_status_check_152ba99e" CHECK ("status" IN ('not_started', 'pending', 'verified', 'rejected', 'needs_review', 'revoked'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."UserSession" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isAdmin" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "lastSeenAt" timestamptz,
  "revokedAt" timestamptz,
  "revokedReason" text,
  "steppedUpAt" timestamptz,
  "tokenHash" text NOT NULL,
  "userAgent" text,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
